description.value: Purple Panda Chi-Thai Bistro is a cozy Thai and Chinese restaurant in Whistler, BC, serving dishes like Massaman Beef Curry, Panang Curry Chicken, and Thai Laksa Curry Noodles. Customer reviews praise its authentic flavours and welcoming atmosphere, making it a notable dining option in a mountain resort town. The restaurant offers daily happy hour specials on appetizers and drinks.
